source_text.body:
Send a weekly competitor intelligence digest
A Claude Code skill collects competitor info from websites, founder LinkedIn pages, review sites and ad libraries, then sends a digest every Monday morning.
·
Apr 3, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster set up Claude Code with an open-source competitor-intel skill and handed it a list of 3 to 5 competitors, including each company’s website, founder LinkedIn page, review pages such as G2 or Capterra, and ad-library links. Claude then used the skill to gather competitor information, scrape reviews, identify which ads were working, and compile a weekly digest that goes out automatically every Monday at 8 AM PT.
How it went
The reported result is simply that it is working pretty well for the poster. The post gives no metrics, examples from the digest, or details on misses, and the available thread view did not expose useful comments with more specifics.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the source only describes the inputs and schedule, not how delivery was wired up or how much time or money it took.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build me a reusable skill that tracks these competitors: [competitor names and URLs]. Each run should check their websites, pricing pages, [LinkedIn pages], review sites like [G2 or Capterra] and ad libraries for changes since last time, then write a one-page digest with the top changes and what I should do about them. Save it as a file in [folder]; before setting up any scheduled send or emailing it, show me the draft and the recipient list and wait for my okay.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/claude/comments/1sbortt/a_claude_code_skill_for_weekly_competitor
